title: Cleanup step before publish
goal: Add a cleanup phase to the pipeline that does what the hand-run VACUUM FULL did (843 -> 532 MB, 2026-11-18), so relinks and republishes stop filling sllaw-etl's 1 GB; and stop publishing kb.mentions, which nothing reads (user).
for_whom: The nightly pipeline on ampere, which must keep fitting in Neon Free's 1 GB without hand cleanups.

done_check.check: A cleanup step runs in the pipeline right before publish writes (only when publish has documents to write): VACUUM FULL on the tables of schemas public and kb, and the run's log shows the database size before and after.
publish no longer creates or fills kb.mentions; the dropped table stays gone after a publish.
The pending full republish (12,275 documents) passes in a Dagster run on ampere, publish and embed green, with the size after cleanup and after publish recorded under 1 GB.

scenarios.steps: Run the Dagster job on ampere with the 12,275 documents waiting to publish.
scenarios.expect: cleanup, publish and embed green; the logged sizes show cleanup gave space back before publish wrote; kb.mentions absent.

scenarios.steps: A run with nothing to publish.
scenarios.expect: cleanup is skipped (no rewrite of unchanged tables).

out_of_scope: Removing the kb copy (the app keeps reading kb).
Moving kb to the app's database (dropped brief kb-in-app-db).

decisions.note: Cleanup goes before publish, not after: it gives back both last publish's kb leftovers and this run's relink bloat in public, so publish has room for its copy.
VACUUM FULL locks a table while it is rewritten; by hand each table took seconds, at 02:00 Colombo, so the app's kb reads wait at most that long.

progress.note: d1, d2 built: downstream.cleanup() (VACUUM FULL public+kb, smallest first, autocommit) runs in publish --apply after the gate check, before the write; sizes in publish's output (mb_before_cleanup, mb_after_cleanup, mb_after_publish); kb.mentions no longer created or filled. test_v2 'ok cleanup' (fake connection: VACUUMs out of a transaction, autocommit restored). Next: copy downstream.py to ampere, Dagster run (d3, s1).

Semantic and security PASS on 93bb9da (security low: VACUUM FULL locks each table for seconds while it is rewritten); pushed to main; downstream.py and test_v2.py copied to ampere (matched 83ad111 before; md5 checked after), test_v2 passes there. pipeline.py unchanged, so no Dagster restart. d3/s1 wait on the run with apply.

Run f0fdfce4 (user's yes): listing..quality_gate green, publish failed in cleanup: 'VACUUM cannot run inside a transaction block' (run.py holds the connection in `with db()`, a transaction in psycopg2 2.9 even with autocommit; the fake-connection test could not see it). Nothing written (cleanup runs before the write). Fix: cleanup gets its own fresh connection; proved on ampere with VACUUM FULL public.marks on a fresh connection while one is held in `with`.

Round 2: semantic and security PASS on 373cdfb (semantic minor: the fresh connection is plain psycopg2.connect, so a DNS blip fails publish before any write; Dagster retries). Pushed, copied to ampere; publish attempt 3 of f0fdfce4 ran the fix. d3/s1 met: run SUCCESS, publish 546 s {to_publish 12275, mb_before_cleanup 664, mb_after_cleanup 531, mb_after_publish 741}, embed 406 s {chunks 277994, in_index 277646, to_upsert 569, to_delete 1}. s2 (nothing to publish) checked from the code only, not run. Merged.
